description: Docs bug: TokenPolicy marks `id` required on token create/update REQUEST bodies, but policy ids are server-generated — Cloudflare rejects client-sent ids and create payloads have none. Drop the member from the request-side policy items ({effect, permission_groups, resources} is the real write shape). Also docs gap: CreateTokenResponse.value is untyped in the docs but is the plaintext token string on the wire (the doc comment even says 'The token value'); v0 typed it string.
